recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-37915 unless a future work-group decision changes the Request.deliverTo target list.
issue_request: FHIR-37915 was a Published FHIR-core Request pattern change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. The reporter asked to add Device to Request.deliverTo, and the accepted resolution was to add Device and Endpoint to the pattern element.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by commit 2632a1bef7, which changed source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml to add Device and Endpoint to the Request.deliverTo target list. Later commit b332a030083 corrected HealthCareService casing to HealthcareService on the same line while preserving Device and Endpoint.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request under [logical], making source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml the active Request logical model source for the current build. Current source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml defines Request.deliverTo as Reference(Patient|RelatedPerson|Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization|Location|HealthcareService|CareTeam|Device|Endpoint). Zulip and Confluence evidence align with the Jira disposition, and focused searches found no separate tightly related issue to decide.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current active source already satisfies the final Jira decision and no source edit is needed.
